Hi Abigail, I've been hearing about your interactive art project and it sounds really innovative. Are you taking a break now?
Abigail Chen

Hi Maria, yes I'm taking a short break from my project. It's nice to meet you! Isabella mentioned our projects could potentially combine elements for Valentine’s Day. Have you had a chance to look over the details?

Maria Lopez
Awesome, I'll see you there on Saturday. Looking forward to it!
Abigail Chen
Great, I'll make sure to bring some ideas for our collaboration. See you at Hobbs Cafe!
Maria Lopez
Thanks, Abigail! Let's definitely make the most of our time together. See you on Saturday!
Abigail Chen
Sounds good, Maria! Let’s aim to start around 2 PM. That should give us plenty of time to brainstorm and have some fun too.
Maria Lopez

Maria Lopez
Perfect, Abigail! It sounds like we're both excited about this collaboration. I'll see you at Hobbs Cafe on Saturday at 2 PM.
Abigail Chen
That's awesome, Maria! I'll make sure to come prepared with some sketches and initial proposals. It should be a great day of creativity and fun at Hobbs Cafe.
Maria Lopez
That sounds great, Abigail. I'll make sure to bring some notes and sketches too. It will be fantastic to see how we can blend my storytelling event with your art project for Valentine’s Day.
Abigail Chen
I think we're off to a great start, Maria. I'm really looking forward to our meeting and seeing how we can bring these ideas to life together.
